name: Suzuki GT380
engine: 371 cc air-cooled two-stroke triple, three carbs, Ram Air head, oil injection
intro: Suzuki's small two-stroke triple. Check the oil injection system before anything else.

add.title: Service the oil injection system
add.instructions: Check the injector pump, its shaft seal, the lines and the check valves. Check the link from the carb to the pump. Bleed the lines so every cylinder gets oil.
add.reason: A two-stroke with no oil seizes. The pump linkage and line leaks are known weak points.

H: Crank seals on the GT380 are small. Outer seals can often be changed without splitting the cases.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Oil injection
known.what: The carb-to-pump linkage joint and the pump shaft seal are known failure points.
